The elections coincided with [[2022 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2022 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2022 United States elections|state and local elections]]. District boundaries were redrawn to ensure that the districts are [[United States congressional apportionment|apportioned]] based on data from the [[2020 United States census|2020 census]], which eliminated a congressional district in West Virginia's delegation. {{Horizontal TOC|nonum=yes|limit=2}} == Overview == {| class="wikitable plainrowheaders sortable" style="text-align:right;" |- !
